node.statement: Finite-dimensional spectral calculus applied to the positive a and ||a-I|| <= d <= 1/2 gives spectrum(a) contained in [1-d,1+d] contained in [1/2,3/2]. Thus a is invertible. If c:=a^(1/2), b:=a^(-1/2), and s:=||c-I||, then bc=cb=I and s <= d: on the spectrum, |sqrt(lambda)-1|=|lambda-1|/(sqrt(lambda)+1) <= |lambda-1|. Also ||c|| <= 1+s.
